Seven Shiny applications covering data analysis, visualization and modelling.
Each one ships inside its own R package and runs locally — there is no hosted
copy to sign up for, and nothing to install beyond the package itself.

::: {.callout-warning}
### Browser hosting has been retired

Apps that were previously hosted in the browser are **no longer available**, and
there is no replacement host. Every app below runs on your own machine with R
installed. Copy the two lines, paste them into the console, and the app opens.
:::

### Linear regression

<p class="lout">Interactive regression output, diagnostics and variable selection.</p>

<p class="lprereq">Interactive diagnostics for a fitted <code>lm</code> model.</p>

```r
install.packages("olsrr")
olsrr::ols_launch_app()
```

## Everything in one app {#xplorerr}

`xplorerr` bundles the whole set behind a single install, and adds a visualizer
the other packages do not have. If you are not attached to a particular
package, start here.

::: {.lcard .lcard-h}
![](../images/hex-xplorerr.webp){.lcover .lcover-hex alt="xplorerr hex sticker"}

::: {.lbody}
<span class="ltrack">xplorerr</span>

### All seven apps

<p class="lout">Descriptive, inferential, visual, RFM, linear and logistic — one package, one install.</p>

<p class="lprereq">Seven launchers. Each opens its own app window.</p>

```r
install.packages("xplorerr")
xplorerr::app_linear_regression()   # linear
xplorerr::app_logistic_regression() # logistic
xplorerr::app_descriptive()         # descriptive
xplorerr::app_inference()           # inference
xplorerr::app_vistributions()       # distributions
xplorerr::app_rfm_analysis()        # segmentation
xplorerr::app_visualizer()          # visualizer
```

::: {.lactions}
[Docs](https://xplorerr.rsquaredacademy.com){.labtn}
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=xplorerr){.labtn}
[GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/xplorerr){.labtn}
:::
:::

:::

## Which launcher should I use? {#which}

Both routes work and reach the same apps. The difference is who owns them.

::: {.lgrid}

::: {.lcard}
::: {.lbody}
<span class="ltrack util">Option A</span>

### One install, seven apps

<p class="lout">Install <code>xplorerr</code> and call any <code>app_*()</code> function. Nothing else to install.</p>

<p class="lprereq">Best if you want the visualizer, or several apps at once.</p>
:::

:::

::: {.lcard}
::: {.lbody}
<span class="ltrack util">Option B</span>

### The owning package

<p class="lout">Install the package that owns the app and call its own launcher.</p>

<p class="lprereq">Best if you already use that package for its non-interactive functions.</p>

::: {.lactions}
[Package reference](https://pkgs.rsquaredacademy.com/){.labtn}
:::
:::

:::

:::

::: {.callout}
### nse2r has no app here

`nse2r` did ship a Shiny app for NSE market data, but the package was
[archived on CRAN on 2023-08-07](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/nse2r) and is
under revival, so it gets no app card. Nothing to install and nothing to link to.
:::
